name: codex-handoff
description: Continue a Codex task in an externally managed sandbox without exporting local OAuth credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Hand a task to a sandbox and collect its result.
interface.longDescription: Creates a portable, redacted task brief, starts a configured sandbox-provider adapter, and polls for its final report. Local Codex OAuth is never copied to the sandbox.
defaultPrompt: Hand off my current task to a configured sandbox
